pieces.Text: Only an evil character can contact a malevolent undead phantom and take the necrologist archetype. If a necrologist becomes nonevil, she can continue to take spiritualist levels, but her phantom ceases to give her benefits while in her consciousness, she can't use bonded manifestation, and if she manifests the phantom, it is no longer loyal to her and likely attacks her and her allies. This alters the spiritualist's alignment.
